description: Book a dock door window for one carrier visit. INBOUND needs at least one known, not cancelled asnNumbers entry; OUTBOUND needs a known cptId or shipmentRefs. The window is half-open [windowStart, windowEnd), on the site's slot granularity, not in the past, inside the door's operating hours and outside its closures, and may not overlap another BOOKED or CHECKED_IN appointment of the door. Refused with a typed error otherwise (door-double-booked, door-unavailable, unknown-asn, asn-already-scheduled, window-in-past, carrier-suspended, ...). Check get_door_availability first. A carrierScac that is in the carrier registry and SUSPENDED is refused (carrier-suspended); an ACTIVE or unregistered SCAC, or none, is accepted as before. Needs an idempotencyKey: retry with the same key and arguments to get the same answer, never a second booking.

agentId.description: optional id of the calling agent, recorded for attribution (max 128 characters)

approvedBy.description: optional id of the human who approved the proposal, recorded for attribution (max 128 characters)

asnNumbers.description: INBOUND: the ASN numbers the visit delivers (at least one, each known and not cancelled, each on no other active appointment); optional for OUTBOUND

cptId.description: optional for INBOUND; OUTBOUND: a cutoff id known for the site (alternative to shipmentRefs)

doorCode.description: the dock door to book; its flow must allow the direction

expectedSealNumber.description: optional seal number the carrier declares; the yard compares it at the gate

idempotencyKey.description: a unique value per logical request, 1..128 printable ASCII characters; retry with the SAME key and arguments to get the stored answer instead of a second change, the same key with other arguments is refused (idempotency-key-reused)

proposalId.description: optional id of the proposal this change executes, recorded for attribution (max 128 characters)

shipmentRefs.description: OUTBOUND: the shipments the visit picks up (alternative to cptId); optional for INBOUND

windowEnd.description: RFC 3339 end of the window (exclusive), after the start and at most the site's max window

windowStart.description: RFC 3339 start of the window; on the site's slot granularity and not in the past

name: book_appointment

description: Cancel a BOOKED or CHECKED_IN appointment and free its door window. reason is CARRIER_REQUEST or SITE_REQUEST (the other reasons are set by policies, never by a caller). Pass expectedVersion to guard against a concurrent change. Needs an idempotencyKey.

agentId.description: optional id of the calling agent, recorded for attribution (max 128 characters)

appointmentId.description: the BOOKED or CHECKED_IN appointment to cancel, appt-<uuid>

approvedBy.description: optional id of the human who approved the proposal, recorded for attribution (max 128 characters)

expectedVersion.description: optional version from get_appointment; the change is refused (precondition-failed) if the appointment is at another version now

idempotencyKey.description: a unique value per logical request, 1..128 printable ASCII characters; retry with the SAME key and arguments to get the stored answer instead of a second change, the same key with other arguments is refused (idempotency-key-reused)

proposalId.description: optional id of the proposal this change executes, recorded for attribution (max 128 characters)

name: cancel_appointment

description: Read one dock appointment by id (appt-<uuid>): door, window, carrier, ASNs or CPT/shipment references, state, latest ETA, recorded arrival, atRisk with its cause, and the version to pass as expectedVersion on a change.
name: get_appointment

description: Read one registered carrier by SCAC: name, usdot, mc, status (ACTIVE or SUSPENDED), suspensionReason and suspendedAt when suspended, and the version to pass as expectedVersion on a change. A SCAC that is not registered is carrier-not-found: that does NOT mean it cannot book, an unregistered SCAC is accepted as before.
name: get_carrier

description: A site's door calendar with defaults applied: booking settings (max window, slot granularity, arrival tolerance, no-show grace), door operating hours (none declared = open 24x7) and the active closures.
name: get_dock_calendar

description: Free and busy windows of one dock door inside [from, to) (RFC 3339, at most 14 days). Free windows respect the site's operating hours and closures and are cut to `minutes` (1..240; default the site's slot granularity). Look here before booking.

minutes.description: optional length of each free window in minutes, 1..240 (default the site's slot granularity)

to.description: RFC 3339 end of the range, after from and at most 14 days later

name: get_door_availability

description: Page through dock appointments ordered by window start (at most 500 per page; follow nextCursor). Every filter is optional: siteId, doorCode, state (BOOKED, CHECKED_IN, COMPLETED, CANCELLED, NO_SHOW), direction (INBOUND, OUTBOUND), carrierScac, atRisk=true (only appointments flagged at risk) and from/to (RFC 3339; appointments whose window overlaps [from, to)).

atRisk.description: optional; true lists only appointments flagged at risk

carrierScac.description: optional carrier SCAC to narrow to

cursor.description: optional nextCursor of the previous page

doorCode.description: optional dock door code to narrow to

from.description: optional RFC 3339 start of the range; with to, appointments whose window overlaps [from, to)

siteId.description: optional site code to narrow to

state.description: optional state: BOOKED, CHECKED_IN, COMPLETED, CANCELLED or NO_SHOW

to.description: optional RFC 3339 end of the range

name: list_appointments

description: BOOKED appointments flagged at risk: the carrier's latest ETA is later than window start plus the arrival tolerance (cause LATE_ETA) or the physical door overlaps a later booking (DOOR_REASSIGNED_OVERLAP). Advisory: nothing reschedules automatically. Optionally narrowed to one site; paged like list_appointments.

cursor.description: optional nextCursor of the previous page

siteId.description: optional site code to narrow to

name: list_at_risk_appointments

description: Page through the carrier registry ordered by SCAC (at most 500 per page; follow nextCursor). Optionally only carriers of one status: ACTIVE or SUSPENDED. A carrier holds its SCAC (Standard Carrier Alpha Code, 2..4 upper-case letters), name, optional USDOT number and MC or MX operating authority number, status and, when suspended, the reason.

cursor.description: optional nextCursor of the previous page

status.description: optional status to narrow to: ACTIVE or SUSPENDED

name: list_carriers

description: Put a carrier in the registry. Idempotent by SCAC: a new SCAC is created ACTIVE (created=true); a SCAC already registered with exactly this data answers it unchanged (created=false); the same SCAC with other data is refused (carrier-already-registered), changing a registered carrier is not offered here. Refused with invalid-scac, invalid-carrier-name, invalid-usdot or invalid-mc. Needs an idempotencyKey.

agentId.description: optional id of the calling agent, recorded for attribution (max 128 characters)

approvedBy.description: optional id of the human who approved the proposal, recorded for attribution (max 128 characters)

idempotencyKey.description: a unique value per logical request, 1..128 printable ASCII characters; retry with the SAME key and arguments to get the stored answer instead of a second change, the same key with other arguments is refused (idempotency-key-reused)

mc.description: optional operating authority number, 1..8 digits with an optional MC or MX prefix (no prefix means MC; stored as MC<digits> or MX<digits>)

proposalId.description: optional id of the proposal this change executes, recorded for attribution (max 128 characters)

scac.description: the carrier's SCAC, 2..4 upper-case letters (assigned by NMFTA)

name: register_carrier

description: Reinstate a suspended carrier so it can book again. Refused when the carrier is not suspended (carrier-not-suspended). Pass expectedVersion (from get_carrier) to guard against a concurrent change. Needs an idempotencyKey.

proposalId.description: optional id of the proposal this change executes, recorded for attribution (max 128 characters)

scac.description: the SCAC of the suspended carrier to reinstate

name: reinstate_carrier

description: Record the carrier's latest estimated arrival on a BOOKED appointment. An etaAt later than the window start plus the site's arrival tolerance flags the appointment at risk once for this report (atRisk=true in the answer); nothing is rescheduled. Needs an idempotencyKey.

agentId.description: optional id of the calling agent, recorded for attribution (max 128 characters)

appointmentId.description: the BOOKED appointment the carrier is on the way to, appt-<uuid>

approvedBy.description: optional id of the human who approved the proposal, recorded for attribution (max 128 characters)

idempotencyKey.description: a unique value per logical request, 1..128 printable ASCII characters; retry with the SAME key and arguments to get the stored answer instead of a second change, the same key with other arguments is refused (idempotency-key-reused)

proposalId.description: optional id of the proposal this change executes, recorded for attribution (max 128 characters)

source.description: optional label of where the ETA came from, at most 64 characters (default mcp)

name: report_eta

description: Move a BOOKED appointment to a new window and/or door (omit doorCode to keep the door). The same checks as a booking apply to the new door and window (a suspended carrier's appointment cannot be moved: carrier-suspended). Pass expectedVersion (from get_appointment) to refuse the change if someone else changed the appointment meanwhile (precondition-failed). Needs an idempotencyKey.

appointmentId.description: the BOOKED appointment to move, appt-<uuid>

approvedBy.description: optional id of the human who approved the proposal, recorded for attribution (max 128 characters)

doorCode.description: optional new door; omit to keep the current door

proposalId.description: optional id of the proposal this change executes, recorded for attribution (max 128 characters)

windowEnd.description: RFC 3339 end of the new window (exclusive)

windowStart.description: RFC 3339 start of the new window

name: reschedule_appointment

description: Suspend a registered carrier with a mandatory reason: from now on a booking or reschedule that names its SCAC is refused (carrier-suspended). Appointments the carrier already holds are NOT cancelled; a person decides about them. Refused when the carrier is already suspended (carrier-already-suspended). Pass expectedVersion (from get_carrier) to guard against a concurrent change. Needs an idempotencyKey.

agentId.description: optional id of the calling agent, recorded for attribution (max 128 characters)

approvedBy.description: optional id of the human who approved the proposal, recorded for attribution (max 128 characters)

expectedVersion.description: optional version from get_carrier; the change is refused (precondition-failed) if the carrier is at another version now

proposalId.description: optional id of the proposal this change executes, recorded for attribution (max 128 characters)
